name: Applied Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Applied Technology Co., Ltd., formed in 1984 with headquarters in Osaka, Japan, provides engineering services across Japan covering GIS (geographic information systems), environmental management, disaster prevention, the manufacturing sector, and civil engineering and building work. Manufacturers can use its systems for supporting quotations, integrating CAD with PLM and managing information. Its GIS services use platforms such as Google Maps Platform and include consulting and custom application development.
